market_pulse.theme: Regulatory changes and licensing in emerging markets
market_pulse.narrative: Multiple competitors report new gambling licences, tighter enforcement, and regulatory updates across Rwanda, Thailand, Bangladesh, Mozambique, Kenya, Ukraine and other jurisdictions, indicating a fast‑moving compliance landscape.

Articles focus on the rise of prediction markets – from tribal gaming lobbying in Washington, to Love Island betting, Gibraltar’s NWiG launch, Meta’s planned app, and Crypto.com’s leadership change – showing growing interest and regulatory scrutiny.

market_pulse.theme: B2B marketing, technology, AI and partnership trends
market_pulse.narrative: Competitors discuss shifts in B2B marketing, AI‑driven data services, new jackpot technology partnerships (Super + ThrillTech), and platform expansions (EveryMatrix lottery division, PlayAIO investment).

market_pulse.theme: Player protection and responsible gambling initiatives
market_pulse.narrative: Coverage includes 1xCare’s advisory committee for player protection, MGA’s crackdown on false‑misleading sites, and broader regulatory focus on consumer safeguards.

Several articles detail senior appointments, M&A activity and strategic board placements – e.g., ZEAL VP at SevenCanyon, Aristocrat’s new COO, Crypto.com’s prediction‑markets chief exit, and CVC’s role at Gaming Laboratories International.

portfolio_wins.topic: Talent acquisition and content leadership within the portfolio
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: Our internal coverage highlights recent senior hires, reinforcing a strategic focus on business development and high‑quality content creation—areas where competitors are largely silent.

portfolio_wins.topic: Strategic insight into high‑profile M&A and investment bets
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: Our internal coverage provides deep strategic analysis of major M&A activity (Icahn’s attempted Caesars acquisition) and unprecedented investment bets (Banijay’s €32bn market play), offering readers unique perspective on valuation and market dynamics.

portfolio_wins.topic: Regulatory focus on crypto/DeFi platform bans
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: We uniquely covered the Czech Republic’s decision to block Polymarket, a crypto‑based prediction market, highlighting the growing regulatory scrutiny of decentralized gambling platforms.

Our portfolio demonstrates active participation in key industry gatherings, exemplified by sponsoring the food court at iGB Affiliate Barcelona, which enhances brand visibility and networking opportunities.

portfolio_wins.topic: Strategic joint ventures and market entry partnerships
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: Our portfolio leads with a high‑profile joint venture between Momentum and Fanatics targeting the UAE market, showcasing proactive expansion into high‑growth regions.
